review_locator: PMCID:PMC6584916, The Role of the Slit/Robo Signaling Pathway; PMID:25245168, Slit/Robo pathway: a promising therapeutic target for cancer
primary_title: Robo2-Slit1 dependent cell-cell interactions mediate assembly of the trigeminal ganglion
decision_basis: The Slit/Robo reviews cite the primary chick-embryo study showing Robo2-Slit1-dependent cell-cell interactions and that blocking or depleting either component disrupts trigeminal ganglion assembly.
limitations_preserved: Preserve chick developmental cell-cell interaction context and perturbation-supported receptor assignment; no SCI inference or universal Robo2 pathway claim.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8573599, Dependence receptors: new targets for cancer therapy; PMID:34077783, UNC5 dependence receptor family in human cancer
primary_title: Dependence receptor UNC5D mediates nerve growth factor depletion-induced neuroblastoma regression
decision_basis: The dependence-receptor review cites the primary UNC5D study showing netrin-1 prevents UNC5D cleavage, release of the proapoptotic intracellular domain, and associated cell death.
limitations_preserved: Dependence-receptor survival/inhibition context; primary functional protection does not resolve purified binding or a canonical kinase relay; no CNS/SCI inference.
